arxiv-1810-06361.title: An Efficient Fault Tolerant Workflow Scheduling Approach using Replication Heuristics and Checkpointing in the Cloud Journal: Journal of Parallel and Distributed Computing
arxiv-1810-06361.creator: Amrith Rajagopal Setlur, S. Jaya Nirmala, Har Simrat Singh, Sudhanshu Khoriya
arxiv-1810-06361.description: Abstract Scientific workflows have been predominantly used for complex and large scale data analysis and scientific computation/automation and the need for robust workflow scheduling techniques has grown considerably. But, most of the existing workflow scheduling algorithms do not provide the required reliability and robustness.

arxiv-2005-13140.title: SSM-Net for Plants Disease Identification in Low Data Regime
arxiv-2005-13140.creator: Shruti Jadon
arxiv-2005-13140.description: Abstract Plant disease detection is an essential factor in increasing agricultural production. Due to the difficulty of disease detection, farmers spray various pesticides on their crops to protect them, causing great harm to crop growth and food standards. Deep learning can offer critical aid in detecting such diseases.

arxiv-2206-08624.title: Theory of ultrafast magnetization of non-magnetic semiconductors with localized conduction bands
arxiv-2206-08624.creator: Giovanni Marini, Matteo Calandra
arxiv-2206-08624.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Giovanni Marini, Matteo Calandra. The magnetization of a non-magnetic semiconductor by femtosecond light pulses is crucial to achieve an all-optical control of the spin dynamics in materials and to develop faster memory devices. However, the conditions for its detection are largely unknown. In this work we identify the criteria for the observation of ultrafast magnetization and critically discuss the difficulties hindering its experimental detection.

arxiv-2206-09076.title: Fair Generalized Linear Models with a Convex Penalty
arxiv-2206-09076.creator: Hyungrok Do, Preston Putzel, Axel Martin, Padhraic Smyth, Judy Zhong
arxiv-2206-09076.description: Abstract Despite recent advances in algorithmic fairness, methodologies for achieving fairness with generalized linear models (GLMs) have yet to be explored in general, despite GLMs being widely used in practice. In this paper we introduce two fairness criteria for GLMs based on equalizing expected outcomes or log-likelihoods.

arxiv-2308-05916.title: An Exploration of Mars Colonization with Agent-Based Modeling
arxiv-2308-05916.creator: Edgar Arguello, Sam Carter, Cristina Grieg, Michael Hammer, Chris Prather, Clark Petri, Anamaria Berea
arxiv-2308-05916.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Establishing a human settlement on Mars is an incredibly complex engineering problem. The inhospitable nature of the Martian environment requires any habitat to be largely self-sustaining. arxiv-2407-00537.title: Accelerating Longitudinal MRI using Prior Informed Latent Diffusion
arxiv-2407-00537.creator: Yonatan Urman ∗ ,, Zachary Shah ∗ ,, Ashwin Kumar, Bruno P.Soares, Kawin Setsompop
arxiv-2407-00537.description: Abstract MRI is a widely used ionization-free soft-tissue imaging modality, often employed repeatedly over a patient’s lifetime. However, prolonged scanning durations, among other issues, can limit availability and accessibility. In this work, we aim to substantially reduce scan times by leveraging prior scans of the same patient.

arxiv-2409-14732.title: Charged current neutrino scattering from nucleons
arxiv-2409-14732.creator: M. Sajjad Athar, A. Fatima, S. K. Singh, F. Zaidi
arxiv-2409-14732.description: Abstract In this work, we study the charged current induced neutrino and antineutrino scattering from the free nucleon target. This study has been performed in the energy range of a few GeV, relevant for the (anti)neutrino oscillation experiments with accelerator and atmospheric neutrinos.

arxiv-2506-12233.creator: Robert R. Bitmead
arxiv-2506-12233.description: Abstract Roadmap Sections and Sidebars 1. Section: Introduction 2. Section: Intentions of control 2.1. Sidebar: Agreeing to terms 3. arxiv-2510-03263.title: Memory Self-Regeneration: Uncovering Hidden Knowledge in Unlearned Models
arxiv-2510-03263.creator: Agnieszka Polowczyk, Alicja Polowczyk, Joanna Waczyńska, Piotr Borycki, Przemysław Spurek
arxiv-2510-03263.description: Abstract The impressive capability of modern text-to-image models to generate realistic visuals has come with a serious drawback: they can be misused to create harmful, deceptive or unlawful content. This has accelerated the push for machine unlearning. This new field seeks to selectively remove specific knowledge from a model’s training data without causing a drop in its overall performance.

marlowe-massacre-paris-1593.creator: Christopher Marlowe
marlowe-massacre-paris-1593.description: The Guise's slaughter of the Huguenots — Marlowe's brutal history play.

pmc-11712432.title: Developing Novel Small Molecule Proteostasis Enhancers for Alzheimer’s Disease (AD)
pmc-11712432.creator: Ajish Ariyath, Warnakulasuriya Mary Ann Dipika Binosha Fernando, Ralph N Martins, Prashant Bharadwaj
pmc-11712432.description: BackgroundThe autophagy lysosomal pathway (ALP) and the ubiquitin‐proteasome system (UPS) are key proteostasis mechanisms in cells, which are dysfunctional in AD and linked to protein aggregation and neuronal death. Autophagy is over activated in Alzheimer’s disease brain whereas UPS is severely impaired.

pmc-12383950.title: How Metaphorical Instructions Influence Children’s Motor Learning and Memory in Online Settings
pmc-12383950.creator: Weiqi Zheng, Xinyun Liu, Ermioni Katartzi, Thomas Kourtessis
pmc-12383950.description: Metaphorical instructions are widely used in motor skill learning, yet their impact on learning and memory processes in children remains underexplored. This study examined whether metaphor-based language could enhance children’s acquisition and recall of body posture-related motor skills in an online learning environment.

pmc-12456382.title: Comparative Life Cycle Assessment of Prussian White and NVP/C‐Based Sodium‐Ion Batteries Based on Primary Laboratory Data
pmc-12456382.creator: Friedrich B Jasper, Manuel J Baumann, Hüseyin Ersoy, Anna Smith, Sebastian Büchele, Nicole Bohn, Joachim R Binder, Dirk Holger Neuhaus, Marcel Weil
pmc-12456382.description: Sodium‐ion batteries (SIBs) are considered the most promising candidate for electrochemical storage after lithium‐ion batteries (LIBs) to meet the globally growing energy storage demand. Assessments to identify environmental hotspots and address them in further development at regular intervals are inevitable to ensure low environmental impact of SIBs in the future.

pmc-12529303.title: A phase I study of AZD8186 in combination with docetaxel in patients with PTEN-mutated or PIK3CB-mutated advanced solid tumors
pmc-12529303.creator: A.M. Schram, N. Takebe, A. Chen, Q. Zhou, A. Iasonos, J. Silber, M. Reynolds, S. Hussain, M. Gavriliuc, L.M. Smyth, D. Garrison, E.E. Dumbrava
pmc-12529303.description: BackgroundLoss of PTEN activity is common in solid tumors and promotes cancer growth through activation of the PI3K pathway. PTEN-deficient tumors have increased dependence on PI3Kβ and are sensitive to PI3Kβ inhibition in preclinical models. Efficacy is further enhanced by the addition of taxane chemotherapy.

pmc-12767372.title: Prevalence and Risk Factors of Bacterial Pathogens Causing Camel Calf Diarrhea in Shabeley and Kebribayah Districts, Fafan Zone, Eastern Ethiopia
pmc-12767372.creator: Dek Kahin Yosef, Abdullahi Adan Ahad, Hassan Abdi Arog
pmc-12767372.description: Infectious diarrhea is one of the most serious health threats to camel calves, causing death and substantial loss. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of bacterial pathogens causing diarrhea in camel calves and identify the associated risk factors in the Shabeley and Kebribayah Districts of the Fafan zone, Eastern Ethiopia.

pmc-13148853.title: The “LIME Wedge”: A Technical Report on a 3D-Printed Radiologic Reference Device for Differentiating Button Battery and Coin Ingestion
pmc-13148853.creator: Peyton J Ware, Carter Ware, Amanda H Bjornstad, Heather M Kuntz, Timothy P Young
pmc-13148853.description: Button battery ingestions are time-sensitive emergencies that require prompt identification and removal. Button batteries can be mistaken for coins, which can lead to dangerous delays in management. We designed the “LIME Wedge” radiologic reference device to hold four coins and one 20 mm button battery.

pmc-13395387.creator: Lei Bao, Xueyu Wang, Yang Zhou, Beibei Zhan, Xiaheng Zhang

pmc-13402355.title: Interactive narratives reveal the personalizing effect of agency on episodic memory
pmc-13402355.creator: Xian Li, Nicole Kim Ni, Savannah J Born, Ria J Gualano, Iris Lee, Buddhika Bellana, Janice Chen
pmc-13402355.description: Humans make choices that actively shape the trajectory of events in their lives. These choices rely on personal knowledge that can influence how these events are later remembered. We study how people’s memory for a naturalistic sequence of events is altered when their choices control the future. Participants read “choose-your-own-adventure” stories with full, partial, or no control over future events.

uslaw-usc-t25-s352.title: 25 U.S.C. § 352 — Cancellation of trust patents within power or reservoir sites
uslaw-usc-t25-s352.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s352.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 9 (Allotment Of Indian Lands). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior, after notice and hearing, is authorized to cancel trust patents issued to Indian allottees for allotments within any power or reservoir site and for allotments or such portions of allotments as are located upon or include lands set aside, reserved.
